There's a general problem with adding only csv and unit tests: while the queries are quite complete, there's nothing that confirms that the pushdowns actually work when used with Lucene. This is the reason why we have run [into this issue](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/99960) and I fear that may not be the last one.

>

> 
> `from employees | where emp_no == 10010 | stats c = count(job_positions) by job_positions`
> 
> ```
>        c       |  job_positions  
> ---------------+-----------------
> 4              |Architect        
> 4              |Purchase Manager 
> 4              |Reporting Analyst
> 4              |Tech Lead        
> ```
